import os

# Function to load and flatten images
def load_and_flatten_images(folder_path):
    """Load all PNG images and create dataframe of pixels"""
    pixels = []
    image_ids = set()

    for filename in sorted(os.listdir(folder_path)):
        if not filename.endswith(".png"):
            continue

        img_id = int(filename.replace(".png", ""))
        img = Image.open(os.path.join(folder_path, filename))
        img_array = (
            np.array(img, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1) / 255.0
        )  # Normalize to 0-1

        row_count = img.size[1]

        for idx, val in enumerate(img_array):
            row = idx // img.width
            col = idx % img.width
            pixels.append(
                {
                    "id": f"{img_id}_{row+1}_{col+1}",
                    "value": val,
                    "pixel_idx": idx,
                    "width": img.width,
                    "height": row_count,
                }
            )
            image_ids.add(f"{img_id}_{row+1}_{col+1}")

    return pd.DataFrame(pixels), list(image_ids)
